title: Well-sourced Ohio ancestor
description: A nineteenth-century Ohio family with six independent sources, both parents named, and a full residence trail. This is what a finished claim looks like.

title: A family story nobody has sourced
description: Everything here is memory. No places, no citations, and a claim that cannot be searched for at all.

title: Two men with the same name
description: Two John Smiths in the same Ohio county, born on different sides of the Atlantic. The classic same-name collision.

title: Yorkshire milliner, parish to probate
description: English parish registers, the 1911 census and the 1939 National Register - plus a child born in 1940, whose generation has a hole where the 1941 census should have been.

title: German immigrant, passenger to naturalisation
description: Passenger list, declaration of intention and naturalisation - with the gap that matters: the arrival port was never recorded, so the passenger list cannot actually be searched.

title: A claim that contradicts itself
description: Two death dates, an ambiguous numeric birth date, a census cited for an exact birth date, and a memorial as the only other source.
